text.text_excerpt: This is my second time trying We Dat. I decided to get the tenders and fries this time with cheese and jalapeño peppers. IT WAS AMAZING!!! I really did enjoy the food and the service. You will most definitely get your money worth because they definitely give you more than enough food! Will most serve back!

I looove We Dats! It's my favorite place to get a chicken and shrimp plate! Fries are bomb! I load them up with sauce! I usually get lemon pepper or wuzzam wings. Shrimp is nice and crispy. The music is always great.. it's a fun place for a date or with friends. I love the staff! Always very nice and welcoming and grateful! Ask for ranch or dipping sauce and try their pineapple lemonade and desserts!! Thanks We Dats!!

Today was a great Sunday! As soon as walked into the restaurant I felt welcomed. The owner, Greg, greeted me from the kitchen as well as other customers. It was heartwarming, because you could clearly see he was in his zone back there but for him to step out and give a beautiful smile to his customers was just dope. The cashier was polite as well. I admired the wall art that has a plethora of local celebs and overall the cleanliness of the place was exceptional. When I got home and opened my plate, I almost wanted to close it back because I wasn't ready for that presentation! I love well proportioned, meaty wings and that's exactly what I got.
